items.text:
Extremely complicated. Nothing is explained. I've died because I didn't understand how docking worked. I've died because I told my character to pry open a crate and he went to get a crowbar from a section of ship that had no atmosphere without a helmet. I've died because I didn't understand the fuel system, ran out of fuel, and just shot across the universe at a relative velocity of 300 meters per second forever without the ability to brake or change directions. I've gotten stuck on a station forever because I couldn't sell my scrap for enough to pay my legal bills and they won't let you leave if you have outstanding fines.

I love it and want to chew on it like a chew toy.
items.text_zh:
极其复杂。什么都没解释。我死过，因为我不明白对接是怎么运作的。我死过，因为我让我的角色撬开一个板条箱，而他却去从一个没有大气层的飞船区域拿撬棍，还没戴头盔。我死过，因为我不明白燃料系统，燃料耗尽，然后以每秒300米的相对速度永远飞越宇宙，无法刹车或改变方向。我曾永远被困在一个空间站上，因为我卖废料赚的钱不够付我的法律账单，而如果你有未缴罚款，他们就不让你离开。

我爱它，想把它像咬咬玩具一样嚼。

observations.description: 因无法出售废料支付法律费用而被困在空间站，且未付罚款无法离开。
observations.evidence: I've gotten stuck on a station forever because I couldn't sell my scrap for enough to pay my legal bills and they won't let you leave if you have outstanding fines.
